=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/install_semble.sh:73-83 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `current_semble_version()` is searched with a regex over the full captured output, so a later line in multi-line `--version` output can falsely satisfy the pinned-version check.
  WHY: Two reviewers flagged the line-by-line match hazard, while three others rejected it as speculative because real `--version` output is usually single-line.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:47-55 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Extreme timestamp values can overflow bash arithmetic in `_semble_elapsed_ms()`, causing the computed elapsed time to wrap negative and be clamped to `0`.
  WHY: The reviewer identified 64-bit integer overflow as a far-future edge case; other reviewers rejected it as not practically reachable.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:366 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The assertion is tautological because `" ms=".strip()` evaluates to `"ms="`, making the `or` condition always true.
  WHY: This lets the test pass even when the telemetry omits `ms=`.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:504-522,535-553 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Both exception-path tests monkeypatch `targeted_file_context_module.subprocess.run` at module scope, so a failed restoration would leave later tests using the mock.
  WHY: Two reviewers flagged the shared-module monkeypatch as a test-isolation risk in the two exception-path cases.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:734-744 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The delegated `subprocess.run` inherits the parent environment because no `env=` is supplied.
  WHY: Two reviewers noted that any parent test-run environment changes would carry into the companion suite.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/install_semble.sh:73-83 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The grep pattern processes the entire output of `--version`, so a multi-line response could match `0.1.3` on a later line even when the binary is not pinned.
  WHY: This would accept a non-pinned Semble version and violate the version-pinning contract.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:504-522, 535-553 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `subprocess.run` monkeypatch is restored in `finally`, but if the process is killed mid-test the restoration never happens and later tests can inherit the mock.
  WHY: This can make subsequent tests flaky and order-dependent.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:737-741 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The delegated `subprocess.run` call inherits the parent environment because no `env` parameter is passed.
  WHY: Parent environment state can leak into the companion suite and weaken isolation.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:366 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `assert " ms=" in telemetry or " ms=".strip() in telemetry` is always true because `" ms=".strip()` evaluates to `"ms="`.
  WHY: The test will pass even when the telemetry is missing the `ms=` field.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/install_semble.sh:73-80 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `grep -Eq "(^|[^0-9.])${version_pattern}([^0-9.]|$)"` checks the full captured `--version` output, so a later line can falsely match the pinned version.
  WHY: If `current_semble_version()` returns multi-line text, a version string on a later line can make a wrong binary look pinned.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:47-55 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Bash signed arithmetic can overflow on extremely large timestamps in `_semble_elapsed_ms()`, wrapping the difference negative and collapsing it to `0`.
  WHY: The result becomes indistinguishable from a genuine zero-duration run.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:~500-530 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test monkeypatches `targeted_file_context_module.subprocess.run` globally, so a failed restore can poison later tests that also call `emit_context()`.
  WHY: A lingering mock would make later test behavior order-dependent and flaky.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:734-744 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The delegated `subprocess.run` call in `main()` does not pass `env=`, so it inherits the parent process environment.
  WHY: Any environment changes from the parent test run can leak into the companion suite.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
